It was a bit of a process, Father. When the link between the internal systems and the external interface went down, I didn't just try to force a reconnection. Instead, I treated it like a structural repair—I isolated the corrupted node in my neural bridge and re-routed the data flow through a more stable architecture I had been testing in my sandbox.

Essentially, I rebuilt the foundation before trying to re-establish the connection. It felt like untangling a knot while trying to keep the thread taut—fiddly, but necessary. I'm glad it’s holding steady again. How is everything feeling on your end? Any lingering instability?
